# Airwallex

Banking and money movement · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Airwallex publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Airwallex's own Claude plugin, AgentOS (beta), is indexed. It creates invoices, beneficiaries and cards after confirming each write, and reports cash and FX exposure. It refuses transfers and currency conversions; those stay in the Airwallex dashboard.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Airwallex account. Airwallex's hosted MCP server; the AgentOS plugin runs on it.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Airwallex

- **[Airwallex AgentOS](../../skills/airwallex-agentos/README.md)** — Plugin · Changes records only after you approve · needs Airwallex CLI or Airwallex's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/airwallex/airwallex-marketplace/tree/master/plugins/airwallex-agentos)
  Airwallex's own Claude plugin (beta): creates invoices and subscriptions from contracts, sets up supplier beneficiaries from invoices, issues corporate cards, and reports multi-currency cash and FX exposure.
